method.kl_primary: KL(teacher||candidate) on the coarsened partition {teacher top-K tokens with known candidate logprob} u {rest}: an exact LOWER BOUND of the full-vocabulary KL (data-processing inequality). method.kl_secondary: top-K renormalised KL over teacher top-K n known (both renormalised): the common top-K approximation, labelled kl_topk_renorm; not a bound.

method.ppl: exp(mean NLL of the true next token) from the same logprobs; teacher PPL recomputed and checked against 3.1995
